groupedSummary.largestProviderFreeReproducibleGroup: The frozen distractor selector admits candidates that pass schema parsing but fail later language or near-duplicate semantic validation. This is reproducible without private data and can be corrected before assembly without weakening validation.

selectedCorrection: Language-aware, Unicode-normalized, semantic duplicate-aware deterministic distractor salvage plus sanitized semantic-stage diagnostics.
selectionRationale: It fixes a reproducible pre-assembly gap shared by non-English semantic artifacts, preserves canonical answers and all application-owned identities, and does not guess unavailable historical validator codes.
